summary: Retested the two niivue mesh-load bugs after main agent applied the RCA fix (option b from iter 6: append original file extension to niivue `name` field, then reset mesh.name = id after load). All 3 retests PASS with ZERO toUpperCase/TypeError console errors. Fix is verified end-to-end on the live preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in NiivueViewer.jsx is correctly applied: addMeshFromFile (lines 290-323) computes ext from file.name via regex (handles .nii.gz double-ext correctly) and only appends if id doesn't already end with it. loadInflatedBrain (lines 327-366) hard-codes '.gii' suffix matching the conte69 mesh URL. In both paths mesh.name is reset to internal id after load so meshMap/lookup keys remain stable. Minimal-diff fix as recommended.

Toast messaging correctly fires success ('Inflated LH loaded', 'Tract loaded · conte69_lh_inflated.gii') with no error toasts. Button state correctly flips to 'LH · ON' after both no-overlay and Polar-Angle paths.
Mesh visibly renders in 3D viewport (gray inflated brain for no-overlay path, orange/polar-angle colored mesh for overlay path) confirming the mesh actually loaded and not just metadata.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-6 RCA bugs fully resolved. NiivueViewer mesh load now works for both no-overlay (surface only) and with-overlay (Polar Angle) paths, plus arbitrary .gii tract uploads via FileUploader. No regressions observed. If new mesh formats (.trk, .tck, .trx, .vtk, .mz3) need testing, repeat the upload-tract-button flow with each format — the regex `/\.[^./]+(\.gz)?$/i` should pick the right ext for all of them.
rca_of_the_issue: Resolved. Root cause was niivue 0.68.2 deriving the mesh-reader from `name` (not url/file.name). Iter-7 fix appends the original extension to the niivue name parameter, then resets mesh.name = id after load to keep internal keys stable. Verified live: 0 TypeError console events across all three flows.
